# Base image with Flux, OpenMPI, and AWS EFA support for ARM64
FROM ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-openmpi:ubuntu2204-efa-arm

# Set environment variables to ensure non-interactive package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Set MPI compilers for the build environment
# These will be used by the configure script
ENV CC=mpicc
ENV CXX=mpicxx

# Download, build, and install the OSU benchmarks in a single layer
# This optimizes the image size by combining dependent steps
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    # Install required build tools and certificates
    build-essential \
    wget \
    ca-certificates \
    autoconf \
    automake \
    libtool \
    # Change to a temporary directory for the build process
    && cd /tmp \
    # Download the OSU Micro-Benchmarks source code
    && wget --no-check-certificate http://mvapich.cse.ohio-state.edu/download/mvapich/osu-micro-benchmarks-7.3.tar.gz \
    # Extract the source archive
    && tar -xzvf osu-micro-benchmarks-7.3.tar.gz \
    && cd osu-micro-benchmarks-7.3 \
    # Configure the build, explicitly setting the MPI C and CXX compilers
    && ./configure CC=${CC} CXX=${CXX} \
    # Compile the benchmarks
    && make \
    # Find all compiled MPI benchmark executables and copy them to /usr/local/bin
    # FIX: Corrected path from 'mpi' to 'c/mpi' where executables are built.
    && find c/mpi -type f -executable -exec cp {} /usr/local/bin/ \; \
    # Clean up the build artifacts and source code
    && cd / \
    && rm -rf /tmp/osu-micro-benchmarks-7.3* \
    # Clean up apt cache to reduce final image size
    && apt-get clean \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a default command to provide usage information for a key benchmark
# This makes the container runnable and verifiable out-of-the-box
CMD ["osu_allreduce", "--help"]

flux-minicluster-manifest.item:
# MiniCluster manifest to run the OSU All Reduce benchmark on AWS ARM instances with EFA.
# This configuration will deploy a 4-node Flux cluster.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A descriptive name for the MiniCluster instance.
  name: flux-osu-allreduce-aws-arm
  # Deploy to the default namespace.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods in the MiniCluster, corresponding to the number of nodes for the job.
  size: 4
  # The total number of MPI tasks to run. With size 4, this maps to 1 task per pod.
  tasks: 4

  # Do not automatically delete the pods and services when the job completes.
  cleanup: false

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Enable strict mode, which causes the job to fail on any error.
    strict: true

  # Flux-specific configuration.
  flux:
    # Specify the target architecture is ARM.
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      # Required setting for ARM-based nodes.
      # NOTE: This setting is technically ignored because 'disable' is true,
      # but it is included here to satisfy the explicit instruction.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-ubuntu:arm-jammy
      # Disable the Flux sidecar container. Flux will be started within the main application container.
      # This is a mandatory requirement for this configuration.
      disable: true

  # Defines the application container to run within the MiniCluster.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:osu-allreduce
      # The command that Flux will execute. 'flux run' is prepended by the operator.
      command: osu_allreduce
      # Always pull the container image to ensure the latest version is used.
      imagePullPolicy: Always
      # This container is the main workload, not a launcher service. This must be false.
      launcher: false
      # Request AWS EFA devices for high-performance networking across nodes.
      resources:
        limits:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: "1"
        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: "1"

manager.name: Build and Deploy OSU AllReduce
manager.description: Build a Docker container and deploy it as a Kubernetes Job.

context.environment: AWS CPU instance in Kubernetes to run across nodes
context.details:
You MUST use ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-openmpi:ubuntu2204-efa-arm as a base image. It includes OpenMPI and libfabric provided from the efa installer for AWS and the entire Flux Framework stack.
You MUST compile setting the cxx compiler to mpicxx and the c compiler to mpicc.
Build the OSU benchmarks. You MUST have MPI support enabled. You MUST ensure osu_allreduce is on the path.
You MUST build for a multi-node MPI environment

context.resources: The resource spec you got earlier is for an autoscaling cluster, so the nodes possible are not there. You must add the nodeSelector to use node.kubernetes.io/instance-type m7g.16xlarge with 64 CPU, 256 GiB Memory, ARM (Graviton3). You are limited to up to 4 nodes.
context.details:
Run The OSU All Reduce benchmark across 4 nodes. 
You MUST run on up to 4 nodes and you MUST set flux.container.disable to true.
You MUST set the containers imagePullPolicy to Always.
The Flux Operator uses flux run in the pwd with the tasks determined by the spec.tasks.
You MUST set resource requests and limits to use vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1
Since this is an ARM instance you MUST change the flux.container.image to be
ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-ubuntu:arm-jammy and set flux.arch: "arm".
